newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Qantas international market share up.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Qantas international market share up.

text.p: Qantas Airways Ltd said on Thursday it carried 40.1 percent of passengers travelling into and out of Australia in September 1996 - an increase of 0.8 percentage points over the figure for September 1995.
It said figures released on Thursday by the Australian Department of Transport showed Qantas passenger numbers for the month increased 11.2 percent over the figure for September 1995.
This was ahead of the 9.1 percent growth in the overall international airline market, it said.
In September 1996, Qantas carried 437,754 passengers on international flights to and from Australia, compared with 393,631 in September 1995, the airline said.
The 40.1 percent market share was greater than the airline's capacity share for the month, Qantas group executive general manager commercial, Geoff Dixon, said in a statement.
Qantas is owned 25 percent by British Airways Plc.
